definitions.explanation: The state of something occurring or being included more than once, or the act of duplicating. Common in administrative, data, and organizational contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{重複|じゅうふく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Check whether there are any duplicates in the data.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込み：03161_moushikomi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{重複|じゅうふく}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{一件|いっけん}→一件：08927_ikken⟧⟦{取|と}り{消|け}した→取り消す：04224_torikesu⟧。
examples.english: The application was duplicated, so I canceled one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{重複|じゅうふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{各部署|かくぶしょ}→各部署：29114_kakubusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明確|めいかく}→明確：01664_meikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: To avoid overlap in tasks, it is necessary to clarify the roles of each department.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
Both じゅうふく and ちょうふく are accepted readings. じゅうふく is the more common pronunciation in everyday use, while ちょうふく is the traditional reading preferred in formal or broadcasting contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重複|じゅうふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧ (to avoid duplication)
- {重複|じゅうふく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{排除|はいじょ}→排除：07631_haijo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to eliminate duplicates)
- {重複|じゅうふく}⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧ (duplicate registration)
- {重複|じゅうふく}⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧ (overlapping portion)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {重複|じゅうふく}: duplication, overlap (formal, systematic)
- ⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}し→繰り返し：10320_kurikaeshi⟧: repetition (general, everyday)
- ⟦{二重|にじゅう}→二重：16893_nijuu⟧: double, twofold (specifically two layers or occurrences)
